test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT not required; no penalty for not submitting. Optional sections (SAT Writing, ACT Science/Writing) are up to the student. Superscored. To change testing status, do so in the applicant portal by Nov 20 (EA/ED I) or Jan 20 (RD/ED II).

requirements.notes: Application = Common App, essay, high school transcript, letter of recommendation, $80 fee. Interviews are not required; Fordham accepts partner interviews (Duolingo, InitialView, Vericant) from international applicants, with interview deadlines Nov 15 (EA/ED I) and Feb 15 (RD/ED II). International CSS Profile due Nov 1 (EA/ED I) or Jan 3 (RD/ED II).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Students whose first language is not English must submit a test or complete the English Language Proficiency Test Waiver Request Form in the applicant portal after submitting. Official scores must be under 2 years old. Applicants in the NYC area may alternatively take Fordham's ESL placement evaluation (FELT).

aid.notes: Review of non-immigrant international applicants is need aware. Partial merit scholarships up to $25,000 (no extra application, for those not applying for need-based aid). Need-based aid goes to a limited number of first-year fall international students who indicate need on the Common App, can demonstrate a family contribution of at least $50,000/yr, and submit the CSS Profile by the application deadline. Awards stay the same for four years.
